description.zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs.

description.zh: 结束时间。使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
- **zh**：简体中文（默认语言）。
- **en**：英文。
description.en:
The language. Valid values:

*   **zh** (default): simplified Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

description.zh:
地域ID。
>您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~143074~~)接口查看集群的地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ* format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-abnormal-pattern-detection --db-cluster-id am-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2011-06-01T16:00Z --end-time 2021-05-18T06:30Z --lang zh --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
